rules.name: rollback
rules.title: Site release rolled back
rules.summary: A new release of the site did not answer, so the site agent switched back to the previous release. The failed revision is not retried until a new commit arrives.

rules.name: content-pull-failed
rules.title: Site content cannot be pulled
rules.summary: The site agent could not fetch the site's repository from the webhost mirror for half an hour. The site keeps serving its current release.

rules.name: agent-failed
rules.title: Site agent failed
rules.summary: The site agent's systemd unit failed. Content changes do not go live until it runs again.

rules.name: egress-not-applied
rules.title: Site egress filter not applied
rules.summary: The site could not resolve the webhost container, so its outbound filter was not rebuilt. The previous rules stay in place.
